rot.ideia.ex1.e1: Now you are on the other side, with Black. Before moving, ask: what does White want?
rot.ideia.ex1.e2: The queen and the bishop aim at f7. The threat is the scholar's mate.
rot.ideia.ex1.e3: The best defense stands between the queen and f7 and, if it can, attacks the queen at the same time.
rot.ideia.ex1.certo: That's right! The pawn blocks the diagonal to f7 and also attacks the queen.
rot.ideia.ex1.revela: The pawn goes to g6: it stands between the queen and f7, and attacks the queen.
rot.ideia.ex1.alt.d8e7.1: That defends too: the queen on e7 protects f7. But she blocks the bishop on f8.
rot.ideia.ex1.alt.d8e7.2: Look at the pawn on g6: it defends and also attacks the queen.
rot.ideia.ex1.alt.d8f6.1: That defends too: the queen on f6 protects f7. But she takes the knight's square.
rot.ideia.ex1.alt.d8f6.2: Look at the pawn on g6: it defends and also attacks the queen.
rot.ideia.ex1.alt.g8h6.1: That defends too: the knight on h6 protects f7. But on the edge it does little.
rot.ideia.ex1.alt.g8h6.2: Look at the pawn on g6: it defends and also attacks the queen.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.g8f6.1: The knight attacks the queen, but does not protect f7.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.g8f6.2: The queen captures on f7: checkmate. It is the scholar's mate.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.g8f6.3: Let's go back: before attacking, defend f7.
rot.ideia.ex1.fora: That is not the move we want. Let's go back: protect f7 or block the queen's path.
rot.ideia.ex1.l1: The white queen has to run. That is the secret: defend by attacking.
rot.ideia.ex1.l2: Remember the idea: see the threat on f7 and defend with a move that attacks the queen.
rot.ideia.ex2.e1: The queen ran to f3 and aims at f7 again, now along the f-file.
rot.ideia.ex2.e2: Once again the threat is mate. Look for a piece that blocks the file and comes into play.
rot.ideia.ex2.p: Block the path to f7, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.certo: That's right! The knight on f6 blocks the f-file and comes into play.
rot.ideia.ex2.revela: The knight goes to f6: it stands between the queen and f7. And it is one more piece in play.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.d8f6.1: That defends too, but the queen takes the knight's square.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.d8f6.2: Look at the knight on f6: it blocks the file and comes into play.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.d8e7.1: That defends too, but the queen blocks the bishop on f8.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.d8e7.2: Look at the knight on f6: it blocks the file and comes into play.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.g8h6.1: That defends too, but the knight on the edge does little.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.g8h6.2: Look at the knight on f6: it blocks the file and comes into play.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.d7d6.1: The pawn opens the way for the bishop, but forgets f7.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.d7d6.2: The queen captures on f7: checkmate.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.d7d6.3: Let's go back: the threat is still on f7.
rot.ideia.ex2.fora: That is not the move we want. Let's go back: the threat is still on f7.
rot.ideia.ex2.volta: Block the path to f7, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.l1: The white queen has made two moves and won nothing. You brought out two pieces.
rot.ideia.ex2.l2: Remember the idea: each time the queen runs, you gain time to bring out pieces.
rot.ideia.ex2.l3: Now I will show the whole defense and one more attack on the queen.
rot.demos.defesa.e1: The defense from start to finish. White tries the scholar's mate very early.
rot.demos.defesa.l3: The queen comes out on the second move.
rot.demos.defesa.l4: The knight protects the pawn on e5.
rot.demos.defesa.l5: The bishop aims at f7: now the threat is mate.
rot.demos.defesa.l6: The pawn on g6 blocks the diagonal from h5 to f7 and attacks the queen.
rot.demos.defesa.l7: The queen runs and aims at f7 along the f-file.
rot.demos.defesa.l8: The knight blocks the f-file and comes into play. Defense done.
rot.demos.deNovo.e1: The queen can still insist. Watch how Black attacks her once more.
rot.demos.deNovo.l1: The queen goes to b3 and aims at f7 with the bishop again.
rot.demos.deNovo.l2: The knight on d4 attacks the queen once more.
rot.demos.deNovo.l3: The queen has to run again, and Black gains another tempo.
rot.demos.deNovo.l4: Now it's your turn: defend against the scholar's mate with Black.
rot.pratica.fechar.enunciado: Defend f7 by attacking the queen. When she runs, block the path with a piece.
rot.pratica.fechar.fim: Well done. The pawn and the knight blocked both paths to f7.
rot.pratica.fechar.err.g8f6: The knight attacks the queen, but she captures on f7: mate. Defend first. Try again.
rot.pratica.contraF3.enunciado: The queen on f3 and the bishop aim at f7. Defend: block the f-file or protect f7.
rot.pratica.contraF3.fim: Perfect. With f7 defended, White's trick does not work.
rot.pratica.contraF3.err.d7d6: The pawn forgets f7: the queen captures there and mates. Try again.
